_source: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1 (tier definitions/examples) and §6.2 (classifier detection list). These are checkbox's own policy choices about a construct's blast radius, not Odoo facts -- `checkbox rules verify` only checks the per-version model/method entries in 17.0.json/18.0.json/19.0.json against real source, not this file.

sudo.detail: sudo() bypasses access rights -- always read every line

with_user.detail: with_user() runs as another user, same exposure as sudo()

execute.detail: raw SQL bypasses ORM constraints and access rights

controller_csrf_exempt.detail: csrf=False on a controller removes CSRF protection

ir.rule.detail: record rule -- changes who can see/write which records

ir.model.access.detail: access rights CSV, per §6.1's amber row

groups_on_menu_or_action.detail: changes who can see a menu/action; not itself ledger-critical, but security-adjacent -- checkbox's own default, not an ARCHITECTURE.md-cited tier

noupdate_data.detail: data marked noupdate is usually meant to survive upgrades untouched; flagging for a second look, not an ARCHITECTURE.md-cited tier -- a data migration on already-posted records is red per §6.1, but that needs the target model's own tier, not this generic flag
